claim_text: The January 24, 2024 indictment in United States v. Mohamed et al., No. 0:24-cr-00015 (ECF 1), alleges 2021 Federal Child Nutrition Program receipts at four family sites: United Youth of MPLS LLC approximately $2.2 million (and FOF paid another approximately $2.8 million to related entities for meals purportedly served at that site); Youth International Club more than $1.4 million; Inspiring Youth & Out Reach LLC more than $1.5 million; and Active Mind’s Youth LLC more than $1 million. These are amount_paid / received charging allegations, subsets of the para 91 more-than-$12 million family figure, and must not be summed with that $12 million or added to HSS or the Bock $250 million headline.

supporting_passages.quote: In 2021, United Youth received approximately $2.2 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds for food and meals it purportedly provided to children.

Based on these fraudulent figures, Feeding Our Future paid approximately $2.2 million to United Youth and another approximately $2.8 million to related entities for meals purportedly served at the United Youth site.
Based on these fraudulent claims, they received more than $1.4 million in Federal Child Nutrition Program funds.
Based on these fraudulent claims, Inspiring Youth received more than $1.5 million in federal child nutrition program funds
Based on these fraudulent claims, Active Mind’s Youth received more than $1 million in federal child nutrition program funds

amounts.methodology: United Youth received approximately $2.2 million (paras 20 and 43). Do not sum the two paragraphs.
Para 43: FOF paid another approximately $2.8 million to related entities for meals purportedly served at the United Youth site.
Youth International received more than $1.4 million (paras 22, 51).
Inspiring Youth received more than $1.5 million (paras 19, 60).
Active Mind’s Youth received more than $1 million (paras 21, 72).

qualifiers: subsets of para 91 >$12 million; do not sum with that figure
do not add to HSS or Bock $250M
